company.description: Valora is a mobile crypto wallet that combines the power of blockchain and mobile with an intuitive user interface to make crypto easy to use. Valora makes crypto useful and accessible even on the most basic smartphones, enabling 6 billion smartphone users worldwide to reliably save, send, and spend crypto as easily as sending a text message.
